zh-CN.name: 维度分层
zh-CN.description: 工作用布局标签：通过前后遮挡、表面色差、边界和必要的阴影表达内容的层级。视觉上前移的元素应对应真实的重要性或交互关系。
use_when: 需要区别主内容、浮层与辅助信息。
覆盖式交互需要清楚的前后关系。
avoid_when: 不必要的遮挡会隐藏内容与操作。
不要把每个元素都做成独立浮层。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 先按信息和交互关系确定表面层级，再用边界、底色和少量阴影表现前后；覆盖层不遮挡必要操作，关闭后恢复原位置的焦点；窄屏减少无意义叠放。

en.name: Dimensional Layering
en.description: A working layout label for expressing depth through overlap, surface contrast, boundaries and selective shadows. Elements that appear closer should have a meaningful priority or interaction role.
use_when: Main content, overlays and supporting information need distinct roles.
Overlay interactions require a clear foreground and background relationship.
avoid_when: Unnecessary overlap hides content and actions.
Avoid turning every element into a separate floating layer.
en.prompt_template: Define surface roles from information and interaction needs, then express depth with boundaries, surface colors and selective shadows. Keep required actions accessible, restore focus after overlays close, and reduce decorative overlap on narrow screens.
